Unovan Form Standard ModeUnovan Zen ModeGalarian Form Standard ModeGalarian Form Zen Mode
Darmanitan is one of several Pokémon that have Region Forms. If caught or bred from a parent that originates in Galar, it will have its Galarian Form
Only Darmanitan with the Zen Mode ability can change form. It changes when HP is less than 50%
